description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ReviewCard, which displays a user review summary including rating, number of reviews, and a breakdown of star ratings with progress bars. It also includes a nested RateBar widget to visualize the distribution of ratings.

classes.name: ReviewCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays overall review rating, number of reviews, and a detailed star distribution with progress bars.

classes.name: RateBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that shows a star rating level and a proportional progress bar indicating review count percentage for that star rating.

methods.name: build (ReviewCard)
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the review summary, including rating display and star distribution bars.

methods.name: build (RateBar)
methods.description: Constructs a row with star label and a progress indicator bar.
